meta.abstraction: Finite user-visible projection of sampled valid traces; merged predicates may over-approximate combinations of hidden preconditions. This is not exhaustive model checking.

meta.description: The person is opening the board board lifecycle view.
checks: No final outcome is claimed before the opening result.

meta.description: The person is viewing the settled chessboard.
checks: The latest position owns displayed pieces, even when older motion finishes.
One capture remnant belongs only to its valid arriving pawn, including during an immediate reply that preserves that pawn in the latest position.
Disabling input puts every piece down and clears selection.
Reduced motion never waits for a moving piece or captured remnant.
Hidden activities retain a settled position without a held piece.
A held piece cannot also be selected.
A closed board has no pieces, gestures or current arrival to observe.
Orientation remains a choice of the activity while its board is open.
meta.projectionReview: Confirm that omitted data do not enable an impossible stitched path.
